prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Houston, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1425; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recording is for claim review purposes. Can you confirm you are comfortable continuing?

A: Yes, that's fine.

Q: Please describe in your own words where the collision took place.

A: It was at a four-way intersection in Houston, Texas. I was heading through on the green light, going straight across.

Q: Which direction were you traveling, and what did you see before impact?

A: I was going east. The light had been green for a little while. I saw the other car coming from my right, and it looked like it was going to run the red. I tried to brake but there wasn't enough time.

Q: Where did the other vehicle strike your car?

A: On the driver's side, the front part of their car hit my door area. My car spun a little and stopped near the curb.

Q: Did you feel any injuries right after the crash?

A: Not right away, I was shaken up. By the next morning my neck was stiff and hurt when I turned my head. I also had pain going up into the back of my head.

Q: Have you sought medical care since the accident?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic the same week, and I've been seeing a physical therapist twice a week since then. They said it looks like whiplash.

Q: Have you missed any work because of your symptoms?

A: I missed a few days and had to change some of my duties afterward because I can't sit at my desk for long periods.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think I've covered it. I just want to get my car fixed and get my neck feeling normal again.

Q: Thank you. That concludes the recorded statement.
